rules.note: Scan of the information page of an ordinary passport valid for at least one year. Former Chinese citizens (UCAS) must also show their Chinese nationality was cancelled.
UCAS asks for a recent two-inch bareheaded photo matching your passport photo. USTC does not list a photo.
Bachelor's degree certificate (scanned original). If you graduate before September 2026, a pre-graduation certificate. USTC wants copies notarised by your Ministry of Education or equivalent.

Master's and bachelor's degree certificates (scanned originals). If you graduate before September 2026, a pre-graduation certificate. USTC wants copies notarised by your Ministry of Education or equivalent.
Complete undergraduate transcript (scanned original). If still studying, official transcripts to date; final ones before registration. USTC wants copies notarised.
Complete master's and bachelor's transcripts (scanned originals). If still studying, official transcripts to date; final ones before registration. USTC wants copies notarised.
Complete CV with your education and research experience from university onward. If employed, attach an employment certificate (UCAS).
Two letters from professors or associate professors who know your work, with their phone and email. UCAS: signed, dated, on letterhead, and not from your intended UCAS supervisor.
UCAS only: motivation letter (why study in China, background, study plan, career goals). Doctoral applicants add their research experience. USTC asks for a research proposal instead.
USTC only: a study or research proposal of at least 1,000 words. UCAS asks for a motivation letter instead.
USTC only: the Foreigner Physical Examination Form (download from the USTC admission page). UCAS does not list a medical form.
For English-taught programmes: IELTS, TOEFL or other proof of English. Not needed if English is your mother tongue.
For Chinese-taught programmes: HSK certificate (USTC: Level 4 or higher; UCAS: Level 5 with at least 180) or other proof of Chinese.
UCAS: up to 5 representative published papers with first page and abstract. Do not send unpublished work.
UCAS: the Supervisor's Acceptance Form, if you have contacted a supervisor and have one.
Only if you are employed: proof of employment (UCAS) and, for USTC, a release permission from your employer.
